notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Maskwood Nexus, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Repeat step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates an infinite mandatory loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.
